id: # The year of the Coptic Orthodox Church, by the Coptic calendar: coptic(04-29)
# is 29 Koiak.  Easter is by the Alexandrian rule, the same as the Orthodox.
# The seven major and seven minor feasts of the Lord are here; the Nativity is
# kept on 29 Koiak, 7 January in the civil calendar.
# The year begins with Nayrouz, 1 Thout.

title: Nayrouz
full_name: Feast of Nayrouz: the Coptic New Year (1 Thout)
